opinions.point: Most commenters enjoyed the episode’s escalating absurd comedy and treated its deliberately silly tone as the main appeal.
Several commenters found the ensemble cast’s goofy interactions and exaggerated reactions especially entertaining.
Many praised the episode’s visual gags, bizarre facial expressions, and intentionally loopy art style.
A minority felt the humor was forced, tonally empty, or too dependent on absurdity, with one commenter saying the show had lost them.
One commenter criticized a recurring villain as harmful to the story and wanted that character removed.

title: Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston

thread.title: Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden • Kyouran Reijou Nia Liston: Byoujaku Reijou ni Tensei shita Kamigoroshi no Bujin no Karei naru Musouroku - Episode 6 discussion

opinions.point: Many commenters enjoyed Nia’s exaggerated enthusiasm for fighting and found her reactions consistently funny.
The relationship between Nia and Neal was frequently praised, especially their supportive sibling dynamic and Neal’s development.
Several viewers liked the Neal-centered match and considered its choreography entertaining.
Commenters were enthusiastic about the ending theme and the prospect of the next episode’s darker tournament setting.
The children’s tournament initially disappointed some viewers because it did not offer Nia the intense challenge she wanted, though they ultimately found it entertaining.
Some found the contrast between Nia’s public image and violent personality amusing, while others viewed the premise as socially awkward or excessive.
A few reactions criticized the episode’s premise involving children fighting or questioned whether that material was satisfying enough.
